Your goal is not simply to help customers use the Coaching.com platform. It is to understand what they are trying to accomplish and help them use our technology successfully to achieve it.</p> <p>You will work closely with senior stakeholders at leading organizations and coaching companies, becoming a trusted partner who understands their goals, anticipates challenges, identifies opportunities, and ensures they receive meaningful value from Coaching.com.</p> <p>This is an opportunity for someone who loves the intersection of technology, relationships, problem-solving, and business growth and wants to help shape an evolving Customer Success function within a growing SaaS organization.</p> <h2>What You'll Own</h2> <h3>Customer Relationships &amp; Success</h3> <ul> <li> <p>Serve as the primary strategic point of contact for a portfolio of Enterprise customers and partners.</p> </li> <li> <p>Develop a strong understanding of each customer's goals, use cases, stakeholders, and measures of success.</p> </li> <li> <p>Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders, including senior and executive-level leaders.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proactively guide customers toward stronger adoption, engagement, and outcomes throughout their lifecycle.</p>
